name: How can I prevent mold from growing on my walls?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent mold from growing on my walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold on walls involves controlling moisture and humidity. Ensure good ventilation in bathrooms and kitchens. Fix any leaks from pipes, roofs, or windows promptly. Use dehumidifiers in damp areas like basements. Keep indoor humidity levels below 60%. Insulate cold surfaces to prevent condensation. Also, ensure proper drainage around your home's foundation and regularly inspect for any signs of water intrusion or dampness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by controlling moisture and humidity. Fix leaks, use dehumidifiers, ensure good ventilation, and keep indoor humidity below 60%.
